title: Mail List
tagline: MailList is a user-friendly email management tool designed to streamline communication and enhance productivity.
description:
Mail List revolutionizes email management with its decentralized solution, enhancing communication and productivity. Seamlessly curate mailing lists, and dispatch mass emails with ease. Its intuitive interface empowers users to efficiently disseminate newsletters, announcements, or marketing campaigns. Moreover, Mail List offers the unique capability to send multiple emails to users subscribed to various lists, ensuring targeted and effective communication. Additionally, Mail List provides a decentralized infrastructure, ensuring robust security and autonomy in managing email communications. Conveniently, Mail List includes a "Subscribe" link, enabling users to effortlessly join mailing lists and stay informed.

how_its_made: I developed the decentralized application (dApp) using React for the frontend and styled it with Tailwind CSS to create a beautiful user interface. For the smart contract development, I utilized Hardhat, a powerful toolchain for Ethereum development, to write and deploy smart contract. Upon completion, I deployed my contracts on the Scroll Sepolia Testnet.
